mapper.select: SELECT account.user_id, account.user_name, account.dept_id, role_entry.role_key, role_entry.ds_type, role_entry.ds_scope, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_menu grant_entry JOIN sys_menu menu_entry ON menu_entry.menu_id = grant_entry.menu_id WHERE grant_entry.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND grant_entry.role_id = role_entry.role_id AND menu_entry.status = '0' AND menu_entry.perms = 'crm:campaign:send') AS sending, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_menu grant_entry JOIN sys_menu menu_entry ON menu_entry.menu_id = grant_entry.menu_id WHERE grant_entry.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND grant_entry.role_id = role_entry.role_id AND menu_entry.status = '0' AND menu_entry.perms = 'crm:campaign:assign') AS assigning FROM sys_user account JOIN sys_tenant tenant_entry ON tenant_entry.tenant_id = account.tenant_id JOIN sys_user_role membership ON membership.user_id = account.user_id AND membership.tenant_id = account.tenant_id JOIN sys_role role_entry ON role_entry.role_id = membership.role_id AND role_entry.tenant_id = account.tenant_id WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.user_id = #{userId} AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0' AND role_entry.deleted = 0 AND role_entry.status = '0' AND tenant_entry.deleted = 0 AND tenant_entry.status = '0' AND (tenant_entry.expire_time IS NULL OR tenant_entry.expire_time > NOW()) ORDER BY role_entry.role_id
SELECT dept_id FROM sys_dept WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND (dept_id = #{deptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{deptId}, ancestors) > 0) ORDER BY dept_id
